ops.text: discover_hooks() (<=12.79.6) never reloaded a hooks package's `_`-prefixed helpers and reloaded hook modules in alphabetical order, so a long-lived worker kept a helper's first-imported code and a hook importing a later-sorting sibling re-bound its old definitions. Hit in Forge-AI/monorepo on 2026-10-02 05:40-05:44 PT: verify_push_before_reporting_done.py kept the pre-#29370 `_stack.pushed()` after the worktree restacked onto #29370 and blocked Stop with "carries unpushed commits" on a pushed branch. Initially misdiagnosed as a missing HOME; the daemon and workers carry HOME. Fixed by evicting `<pkg>.*` from sys.modules and re-importing each pass (branch loader-reload-hook-helpers). Plugin packs re-exec files via spec_from_file_location but their `_` helpers resolve through a cached package `__path__`, worth a look if packs change under a live worker.
